cohort: 606 women undergoing TOLAC and 606 nulliparas at term in spontaneous labor with vertex singletons and no more than one prior cesarean delivery
finding: Women undergoing TOLAC were more likely to have a cesarean delivery, hemorrhage, or uterine rupture, but those with a predicted likelihood of VBAC of 70% or more did not experience these outcomes at a significantly higher rate.
mod_finding: Women undergoing TOLAC were more likely to have a cesarean delivery, hemorrhage, or uterine rupture compared to nulliparas.
